name: com.tmapmobility.tmap.automotive.voiceassistant.NuguAutoBroadcastReceiver
description: When NUGU Auto requests a connection, this TMAP Mobility Automotive SDK receiver reconnects the TMAP voice assistant so in-car voice requests can reach navigation.
disableEffect: NUGU Auto cannot bind to TMAP's voice assistant, so its in-car voice-navigation integration stops.
